digest.component_or_area: fetcher.fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers and Cloud adapter pagination stall propagation
propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall error hierarchy that fetch_snapshot's enrichment re-raise clauses match against.

The three enrichment re-raise clauses in fetch_snapshot (parent, comment, issuelink handlers) match only BackendPaginationStallError, causing Cloud stalls to fall through to the broad except Exception handlers that log a warning and degrade instead of propagating.

When a Cloud cursor stalls during enrichment, fetch_snapshot writes a silently degraded snapshot and returns success instead of aborting the pass, making missing parents and links undetectable to the differ.

The fix changes RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError while preserving RuntimeError in its MRO, enabling the three fetcher re-raise clauses to catch Cloud stalls and propagate them correctly.

All existing except RunawayPaginationError and except RuntimeError sites remain unaffected by the fix because RunawayPaginationError stays in the exception hierarchy and the adapter-to-core import direction is already established.
